title: Final result artifact
description: The report sent to the lecturer and the input to the league table. Every `required` entry is book-mandated: tokens per game and per series under rule 54 (p.133/280), four repository links under rule 49 (p.133/279), per-sub-game scores and the cumulative series result (p.78/182), the commit hash used in each game (p.40/106), and mutual agreement under rule 35 (p.131/275). additionalProperties is TRUE because the book is NOT-SPECIFIED on extra fields here; what it does forbid is a CONTRADICTING report, which scores 0 for both teams.

groups.description: Rule 49 wants four repository links across both groups. Counted per group, because one group carrying four would satisfy a naive total.

sub_games.description: p.78/182: results and score for each of the six sub-games separately.

tokens.description: Rule 54: per game. A missing count and a zero count are different claims.

github_commit.description: p.40/106: the commit used in THIS game. The reference hard-codes the string 'unknown' here. Hex-only rather than a length floor, because 'unknown' is exactly seven characters and passed minLength -- caught by this schema's own test.

final_result.description: p.78/182: the cumulative weighted series result, plus rule 54's series token total.

mutual_agreement.description: Rule 35, p.131/275: both sides agree the outcome. A conflicting report disqualifies the game and scores 0 for BOTH teams, which is why catching an opponent's forgery is not a reason to file our own contradicting report.
